Ew Hey, William. Have you heard from Dolores at the
Saint Petersburg factory yet? ® We need feedback on
the new electroplating machines. Our goal this month
is 1,000 trumpets, which isn't going to happen if those
machines aren't working well.
I haven't heard from her this morning, so I'm planning
to call her right after lunch.
w OK. ®Speaking of lunch, a couple of us are headed to
the noodle shop downstairs. Do you want to come?
Em I'm working on a financial report.
w I understand. Well, ®let me know what Dolores says.
Those machines were a major investment for us
and I'm worried that they won't be efficient enough to
warrant the expense.
